claims.evidence_en: A process for preparing tembotrione A process for preparing tembotrione The present invention discloses a process for the preparation of tembotrione, belonging to the technical field of organic chemical industry. The process uses sodium trifluoroethoxide to react with methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate, and the resulting 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid is condensed and rearranged with 1,3-cyclohexanedione to prepare tembotrione. The preparation process for tembotrione provided by the present invention overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional process, in which methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate is used with trifluoroethanol and potassium tert-butoxide to prepare 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid in low yield and the potassium tert-butoxide reagent is expensive; at the same time it overcomes the shortcoming of the route in which the carboxyl group is converted to the acid chloride and then to the ester followed by rearrangement, which requires the highly toxic catalyst acetone cyanohydrin. It has the advantages of high yield, low cost, ease of operation, little pollution and safety for the environment, and is suitable for large-scale industrial production. The present invention relates to the field of organic chemical technology, and specifically to a process for preparing tembotrione. Tembotrione is to date a class of herbicide with relatively high activity, low application rate and comparatively good safety. Its industrial preparation is mainly the trifluoroethanol / potassium tert-butoxide method to prepare the key intermediate 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, followed by acyl chlorination of the carboxyl group, esterification and then rearrangement; this method gives a relatively low yield of finished product and uses expensive reagents. Among these, in preparing the key intermediate 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, potassium tert-butoxide is used as the base, the yield is relatively low and the reagent is expensive; the acyl chlorination / esterification / rearrangement route requires the highly toxic reagent acetone cyanohydrin as rearrangement catalyst, and requires thionyl chloride (written thionyl chloride) as the acyl chlorinating agent, and thionyl chloride is very harmful to the environment. A process for preparing tembotrione

The present invention discloses a process for the preparation of tembotrione, belonging to the technical field of organic chemical industry. The process uses sodium trifluoroethoxide to react with methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate, and the resulting 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid is condensed and rearranged with 1,3-cyclohexanedione to prepare tembotrione. The preparation process for tembotrione provided by the present invention overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional process, in which methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate is used with trifluoroethanol and potassium tert-butoxide to prepare 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid in low yield and the potassium tert-butoxide reagent is expensive; at the same time it overcomes the shortcoming of the route in which the carboxyl group is converted to the acid chloride and then to the ester followed by rearrangement, which requires the highly toxic catalyst acetone cyanohydrin. It has the advantages of high yield, low cost, ease of operation, little pollution and safety for the environment, and is suitable for large-scale industrial production.

evidence_lines.text_en: A process for preparing tembotrione
A process for preparing tembotrione

The present invention discloses a process for the preparation of tembotrione, belonging to the technical field of organic chemical industry. The process uses sodium trifluoroethoxide to react with methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate, and the resulting 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid is condensed and rearranged with 1,3-cyclohexanedione to prepare tembotrione. The preparation process for tembotrione provided by the present invention overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional process, in which methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate is used with trifluoroethanol and potassium tert-butoxide to prepare 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid in low yield and the potassium tert-butoxide reagent is expensive; at the same time it overcomes the shortcoming of the route in which the carboxyl group is converted to the acid chloride and then to the ester followed by rearrangement, which requires the highly toxic catalyst acetone cyanohydrin. It has the advantages of high yield, low cost, ease of operation, little pollution and safety for the environment, and is suitable for large-scale industrial production.

evidence_lines.text_en: A process for preparing tembotrione
A process for preparing tembotrione

The present invention discloses a process for the preparation of tembotrione, belonging to the technical field of organic chemical industry. The process uses sodium trifluoroethoxide to react with methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate, and the resulting 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid is condensed and rearranged with 1,3-cyclohexanedione to prepare tembotrione. The preparation process for tembotrione provided by the present invention overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional process, in which methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate is used with trifluoroethanol and potassium tert-butoxide to prepare 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid in low yield and the potassium tert-butoxide reagent is expensive; at the same time it overcomes the shortcoming of the route in which the carboxyl group is converted to the acid chloride and then to the ester followed by rearrangement, which requires the highly toxic catalyst acetone cyanohydrin. It has the advantages of high yield, low cost, ease of operation, little pollution and safety for the environment, and is suitable for large-scale industrial production.

claims.claimed_en: Tembotrione is to date a class of herbicide with relatively high activity, low application rate and comparatively good safety. Its industrial preparation is mainly the trifluoroethanol / potassium tert-butoxide method to prepare the key intermediate 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, followed by acyl chlorination of the carboxyl group, esterification and then rearrangement; this method gives a relatively low yield of finished product and uses expensive reagents. Among these, in preparing the key intermediate 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, potassium tert-butoxide is used as the base, the yield is relatively low and the reagent is expensive; the acyl chlorination / esterification / rearrangement route requires the highly toxic reagent acetone cyanohydrin as rearrangement catalyst, and requires thionyl chloride (written thionyl chloride) as the acyl chlorinating agent, and thionyl chloride is very harmful to the environment.

evidence_lines.text_en: A process for preparing tembotrione
A process for preparing tembotrione

The present invention discloses a process for the preparation of tembotrione, belonging to the technical field of organic chemical industry. The process uses sodium trifluoroethoxide to react with methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate, and the resulting 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid is condensed and rearranged with 1,3-cyclohexanedione to prepare tembotrione. The preparation process for tembotrione provided by the present invention overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional process, in which methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate is used with trifluoroethanol and potassium tert-butoxide to prepare 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid in low yield and the potassium tert-butoxide reagent is expensive; at the same time it overcomes the shortcoming of the route in which the carboxyl group is converted to the acid chloride and then to the ester followed by rearrangement, which requires the highly toxic catalyst acetone cyanohydrin. It has the advantages of high yield, low cost, ease of operation, little pollution and safety for the environment, and is suitable for large-scale industrial production.

evidence_lines.text_en: A process for preparing tembotrione
A process for preparing tembotrione

The present invention discloses a process for the preparation of tembotrione, belonging to the technical field of organic chemical industry. The process uses sodium trifluoroethoxide to react with methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate, and the resulting 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid is condensed and rearranged with 1,3-cyclohexanedione to prepare tembotrione. The preparation process for tembotrione provided by the present invention overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional process, in which methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate is used with trifluoroethanol and potassium tert-butoxide to prepare 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid in low yield and the potassium tert-butoxide reagent is expensive; at the same time it overcomes the shortcoming of the route in which the carboxyl group is converted to the acid chloride and then to the ester followed by rearrangement, which requires the highly toxic catalyst acetone cyanohydrin. It has the advantages of high yield, low cost, ease of operation, little pollution and safety for the environment, and is suitable for large-scale industrial production.

claims.claimed_en: The present invention discloses a process for the preparation of tembotrione, belonging to the technical field of organic chemical industry. The process uses sodium trifluoroethoxide to react with methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate, and the resulting 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid is condensed and rearranged with 1,3-cyclohexanedione to prepare tembotrione. The preparation process for tembotrione provided by the present invention overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional process, in which methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate is used with trifluoroethanol and potassium tert-butoxide to prepare 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid in low yield and the potassium tert-butoxide reagent is expensive; at the same time it overcomes the shortcoming of the route in which the carboxyl group is converted to the acid chloride and then to the ester followed by rearrangement, which requires the highly toxic catalyst acetone cyanohydrin. It has the advantages of high yield, low cost, ease of operation, little pollution and safety for the environment, and is suitable for large-scale industrial production.

The preparation process for tembotrione provided by the present invention overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional process, in which methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate is used with trifluoroethanol and potassium tert-butoxide to prepare 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid in low yield and the potassium tert-butoxide reagent is expensive; at the same time it overcomes the shortcoming of the route in which the carboxyl group is converted to the acid chloride and then to the ester followed by rearrangement, which requires the highly toxic catalyst acetone cyanohydrin. It has the advantages of high yield, low cost, ease of operation, little pollution and safety for the environment, and is suitable for large-scale industrial production.

The preparation process for tembotrione provided by the present invention overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional process, in which methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate is used with trifluoroethanol and potassium tert-butoxide to prepare 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid in low yield and the potassium tert-butoxide reagent is expensive; at the same time it overcomes the shortcoming of the route in which the carboxyl group is converted to the acid chloride and then to the ester followed by rearrangement, which requires the highly toxic catalyst acetone cyanohydrin. It has the advantages of high yield, low cost, ease of operation, little pollution and safety for the environment, and is suitable for large-scale industrial production. claims.claimed_en: Tembotrione is to date a class of herbicide with relatively high activity, low application rate and comparatively good safety. Its industrial preparation is mainly the trifluoroethanol / potassium tert-butoxide method to prepare the key intermediate 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, followed by acyl chlorination of the carboxyl group, esterification and then rearrangement; this method gives a relatively low yield of finished product and uses expensive reagents. claims.evidence_en: Tembotrione is to date a class of herbicide with relatively high activity, low application rate and comparatively good safety. Its industrial preparation is mainly the trifluoroethanol / potassium tert-butoxide method to prepare the key intermediate 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, followed by acyl chlorination of the carboxyl group, esterification and then rearrangement; this method gives a relatively low yield of finished product and uses expensive reagents. Among these, in preparing the key intermediate 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, potassium tert-butoxide is used as the base, the yield is relatively low and the reagent is expensive; the acyl chlorination / esterification / rearrangement route requires the highly toxic reagent acetone cyanohydrin as rearrangement catalyst, and requires thionyl chloride (written thionyl chloride) as the acyl chlorinating agent, and thionyl chloride is very harmful to the environment. (54) Title of invention

(57) Abstract

The present invention discloses a process for the preparation of tembotrione, belonging to the technical field of organic chemical industry. The process uses sodium trifluoroethoxide to react with methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate, and the resulting 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid is condensed and rearranged with 1,3-cyclohexanedione to prepare tembotrione. The preparation process for tembotrione provided by the present invention overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional process, in which methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate is used with trifluoroethanol and potassium tert-butoxide to prepare 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid in low yield and the potassium tert-butoxide reagent is expensive; at the same time it overcomes the shortcoming of the route in which the carboxyl group is converted to the acid chloride and then to the ester followed by rearrangement, which requires the highly toxic catalyst acetone cyanohydrin. It has the advantages of high yield, low cost, ease of operation, little pollution and safety for the environment, and is suitable for large-scale industrial production.

Tembotrione is to date a class of herbicide with relatively high activity, low application rate and comparatively good safety. Its industrial preparation is mainly the trifluoroethanol / potassium tert-butoxide method to prepare the key intermediate 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, followed by acyl chlorination of the carboxyl group, esterification and then rearrangement; this method gives a relatively low yield of finished product and uses expensive reagents. Among these, in preparing the key intermediate 2-chloro-3-trifluoroethoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, potassium tert-butoxide is used as the base, the yield is relatively low and the reagent is expensive; the acyl chlorination / esterification / rearrangement route requires the highly toxic reagent acetone cyanohydrin as rearrangement catalyst, and requires thionyl chloride (written thionyl chloride) as the acyl chlorinating agent, and thionyl chloride is very harmful to the environment.
